title: Glue Job Failure - enrollments-eaf-dataload-job
description: Standard remediation for the enrollments-eaf-dataload-job AWS Glue job. Classifies the failure from the CloudWatch 'Failure Reason' log content before acting - a member api failure referencing an undefined 'span_pbp_view' is a data-dependency error, not a transient one, so it always requires human review rather than an automatic retry.
match_rule: Match on the literal substring 'member api' (case-insensitive) appearing anywhere in the log event's Failure Reason / error message text, typically combined with 'span_pbp_view' being reported as undefined (e.g. 'member api Failure: span_pbp_view undefined'). This indicates the job depends on an upstream member api / view that is missing or not yet available - a data-dependency issue, not something a blind retry would fix.
recommendation: Do not auto-retry this job. Recommend that a human support analyst confirm the member api / span_pbp_view dependency is healthy (check whether the upstream view exists and is populated) before the job is rerun manually. This SOP has been flagged to route directly to a human support analyst to review the failure and decide the next step

example_log_events.description: Real GlueETLJobExceptionEvent - member api failure with span_pbp_view undefined
example_log_events.raw_event:
{"Event": "GlueETLJobExceptionEvent", "Timestamp": 1783513907401, "Failure Reason": "Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/tmp/enrollments_eaf_dataload.py", line 42, in <module>
    raise RuntimeError(
RuntimeError: member api Failure: span_pbp_view undefined", "script": "enrollments_eaf_dataload.py"}
example_log_events.why: The Failure Reason references a member api failure with 'span_pbp_view' undefined - an upstream data-dependency issue, not a transient error, so this requires human review rather than an automatic retry.

decision_tree.name: Classify the enrollments-eaf-dataload-job failure from the Failure Reason log content
decision_tree.instruction: Read the 'Failure Reason' field (or equivalent error/exception text) from the job's CloudWatch log event. Check whether it references a member api failure and/or 'span_pbp_view' being undefined - see match_rule above.

conditions.if: Failure Reason contains 'member api' (case-insensitive) and/or references 'span_pbp_view' as undefined
conditions.note: Upstream member api / view dependency failure - not transient, cannot be safely auto-retried. This has been flagged for a human support analyst to review the failure and decide the next step. The approval-request email is sent automatically as part of the human-approval flow, with the job name, run ID, and full error message.

conditions.if: Failure Reason does NOT reference the member api or span_pbp_view (any other error)
conditions.note: Not covered by this SOP's specific match rule - fall back to a human support analyst for review and decision. For generic transient/connection-refused Glue failures on other jobs, see SOP-GLUE-501 / SOP-GLUE-CETL-501 instead.

feedback_notes: This job's member api / span_pbp_view failure .
